chunks: From him, from Musa ibn Bakr, from Ali ibn Sa'id, who said:

I said to Zurarah: 'Bukayr ibn A'yan narrated to me from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) that 'the arrows do not increase (in share).' He said: 'This is what there is no difference of opinion among our companions regarding from Abu Ja'far and Abu Abdillah (peace be upon them).'

key_terms.تَعُولُ: They increase (referring to the method of 'awwal where shares are proportionally increased)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on 'awwal (increasing shares) in Shia inheritance law according to the Imams?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the Shia juristic consensus (*ijma'*) regarding the 'awwal' (increase) method in inheritance, where the remainder of the estate is distributed among fixed-share heirs rather than being retained by the treasury. Zurarah’s confirmation that this ruling is undisputed among the Shia scholars (*ashab*) from both Imam al-Baqir and Imam al-Sadiq underscores its foundational status in Usuli jurisprudence. This establishes a distinct legal principle separating Shia inheritance law from other schools that may apply 'awwal' differently or distribute the surplus to the state.
